ei.title: Distress and Eustress: Two Sides of Stress

fullPassage: When you are about to go on stage or perhaps take the microphone in a work presentation, do you feel sweaty, get flushed, have a dry mouth, or taste metal? Before taking an exam, does your breathing quicken? These are signs of your body activating your stress response or sympathetic nervous system. But stress is bad, right? Actually, stress isn't always bad. In fact, there are two types of stress: distress (what we normally think of as "stress") and eustress (beneficial stress that motivates us). Coming from the same root as the word euphoria ("eu" meaning good), eustress has been shown to induce different physiological changes to distress, including less strain on your cardiovascular system and a burst of the love hormone oxytocin, which helps heal damage to your heart. Meditation techniques can channel distress into eustress to help you approach whatever challenge or task you face with a clear, calm mind that is ready to focus.

다음 주어진 단어를 모두 사용하여 올바른 문장을 완성하시오. (대소문자 구분 없음, 마침표 생략 가능)

[ isn't / stress / bad / Actually / always ] (5단어) (영어로)

det.korean: 실제로, 스트레스는 항상 나쁜 것은 아니다.
det.analysis:
✅ Actually, stress isn't always bad: 부사 + 주어 + 동사 + 부사 + 형용사.
어순: Actually / stress isn't / always bad

questions.passage: When you are about to go on stage or perhaps take the microphone in a work presentation, do you feel sweaty, get flushed, have a dry mouth, or taste metal? Before taking an exam, does your breathing quicken? These are signs of your body ____ your stress response or sympathetic nervous system. But stress is bad, right? Actually, stress isn't always bad. In fact, there are two types of stress: distress (what we normally think of as "stress") and eustress (beneficial stress that motivates us). Coming from the same root as the word euphoria ("eu" meaning good), eustress has been shown to induce different physiological changes to distress, including less strain on your cardiovascular system and a burst of the love hormone oxytocin, which helps heal damage to your heart. Meditation techniques can channel distress into eustress to help you approach whatever challenge or task you face with a clear, calm mind that is ready to focus.
questions.stem: 다음 한국어 문장의 영어 표현을 조건에 맞게 (영어로) 쓰시오. "이것들은 몸이 스트레스 반응을 __________ 신호이다." 조건: 'activate'를 활용하여 1단어로 쓸 것 (현재분사)

det.korean: activating — activate의 현재분사.
det.analysis:
✅ activating: 현재분사. body activating = 몸이 활성화하는.
❌ activated: 과거분사. 능동 의미 부적절.
❌ activate: 동사원형. 분사 조건.

det.korean: two types of stress — 두 가지 유형의 스트레스.

✅ two types of stress: 원문 그대로.
